svg.title: Which job of a Nextcloud app holds which secret
svg.desc: The release workflow enters no environment and passes the build only the name of the key. The build enters the environment signing, which holds the key that signs the app and nothing else, and fails without it. The delivery to the App Store enters appstore, which holds the token of the App Store and nothing else. Register the app signs the app id in a job in signing and hands the signature and the certificate, neither of them secret, to a job in appstore that posts them.
